name: Trial started
description: Confirms a free trial has begun, states plainly when it ends and what happens then, and points at the first thing worth doing.

origin.note: Design: soft product — pastel split opening, rounded geometry, the end date restated in a bar.

subject: Your {{ product.name }} trial is running
preheader: Full access until {{ trial_ends_at }}. No card on file, nothing to cancel.

credits.author: Kampus
credits.title: Four people working in the office

plan_name.description: Plan the trial grants access to.

trial_days.description: Length of the trial in days.

trial_ends_at.description: Human-readable end date. State it explicitly — "14 days" makes people do arithmetic.

card_required.description: Whether a card is on file. Drives the sentence about what happens at the end, which is the sentence people actually look for.

hero_image.description: Optional image for the opening split. Leave empty for a text-only opening, which is faster and survives image blocking.

included.description: What the trial unlocks, as `text` / optional `detail`. Concrete capabilities, not adjectives.

included_heading.description: Heading above the list of what is included.

plans_url.description: Optional secondary action for people who want to see pricing before the trial ends.

closing.default: We'll remind you before the trial ends. No surprise charges either way.
